First, note that time zones as we know them did not exist in 1711.  
But if we apply modern time zone definitions:  
US/Eastern = UTC-5 (ignoring DST for 1711).  
Asia/Kolkata = UTC+5:30.  

Time difference = (UTC+5:30) − (UTC-5) = 10 hours 30 minutes ahead.  

4:00 AM (May 10, 1711, US/Eastern) + 10h30m = 14:30 (2:30 PM) on May 10, 1711, Asia/Kolkata.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1711-05-10 14:30
